cohort: 149 women (1 excluded) with term pregnancies who underwent labor preinduction with a cervical ripening balloon at Sestre milosrdnice University Hospital Center
finding: The use of a cervical ripening balloon for labor preinduction appears to be safe and efficient, and may increase the rate of vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Multiparity, greater cervical dilation after balloon removal, and use of epidural analgesia were associated with a decreased risk of cesarean section, while gestational diabetes and oligohydramnios were associated with an increased risk of cesarean section.
